## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 However, automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal Pali formulaic reuse, finding 44 matching passages across 16 different Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. This reuse consists primarily of conventional Apadāna stock verses shared with other short flower-offering poems in the *Therāpadāna*. The highest degree of overlap is found with the *Kaṇaverapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 164, where segments 3.1–7.1 closely match 4.1–8.1), the *Pañcahatthiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 186), the *Naḷinakesariyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 245), the *Pupphacchattiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 331), and the *Nāgakesariyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 244) [DharmaNexus]. Shared segments are also aligned with verses cited in the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
